_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/copies/test_copy_spells_cast_this_way.py. t_finale is Finale of Promise without its X: cast up to one target instant and up to one target sorcery card from your graveyard free, exiled instead of binned, then copy each of those spells twice.

cards.name: Test Finale
cards.oracle_text: You may cast up to one target instant card and/or up to one target sorcery card from your graveyard without paying their mana costs. If a spell cast this way would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead. Copy each of those spells twice. You may choose new targets for the copies.
